## BLUF

Render the hint labels in **JetBrains Mono NL** (the no-ligatures cut; letterforms
identical to JetBrains Mono), bundled into the assembly so it is self-contained, and
make the family configurable via a new hot-reload `HintFontFamily` key (default
`JetBrains Mono NL`). The current label font is **hardcoded** (`Helvetica, Arial`,
`HintCanvas.cs:24`); only the size is configurable today (`HintFontSize`,
`App.config:128`). Scope: **the labels only** (`HintCanvas`); the chrome badges
(`OverlayView.xaml:37,41,47,53,59,64` = Helvetica; `:80` = Consolas) are out of scope.

## Why plain JetBrains Mono NL (not a Nerd Font)

- The labels are typeable ASCII — `HintCharacters` = A–Z plus an optional punctuation
  set (CLAUDE.md); matched by the keyboard hook, which only captures A–Z + configured
  punctuation. A **Nerd Font** = base font + icon glyphs in the PUA; the icon glyphs
  cannot be typed or used as labels, and the A–Z letters render **identically** to the
  base font. So for the labels, a Nerd Font adds ~10–15 MB of binary weight with zero
  visual benefit. Plain JetBrains Mono (or its NL cut) gives the same look at ~420 KB.
- **NL (no-ligatures) cut:** JetBrains Mono has programming ligatures (`//`, `->`, `!=`…).
  With the default A–Z `HintCharacters` no ligature can fire, but if a user opts into the
  punctuation set, a label like `//` would render as a ligature. The NL cut (same
  letterforms, ligatures disabled) removes that risk entirely at the same size. **Chosen.**

## Font identity (verified, not from memory)

Parsed the TTF name tables with `fc-query` **and** `fontTools.ttLib` (both agree):

- `JetBrainsMonoNL-Regular.ttf`, `JetBrainsMonoNL-Bold.ttf` → family name
  **`JetBrains Mono NL`** (nameID 1; no nameID 16 → WPF keys off exactly this string).
- Both cuts share the family name with Regular/Bold styles → WPF resolves the Bold
  label weight (`HintCanvas` uses `FontWeights.Bold`) from the folder.

WPF silently falls back to a default font if the pack-URI family name is off by one
character — and this cannot be tested on the dev box (Linux) — so the verified family
name is load-bearing. Version bundled: **v2.304**.

## Design

### Packaging (non-SDK .NET 4.5.1 csproj)

- Add `src/HuntAndPeck/Fonts/JetBrainsMonoNL-Regular.ttf` + `JetBrainsMonoNL-Bold.ttf`
  as `<Resource Include="Fonts\…" />` (embedded in the assembly, resolved via pack URI).
  `<Resource>` (not `<Content>`/`<None>`) so it ships inside `hap.exe`.
- Add `Fonts\OFL.txt` as `<None Include>` — the SIL OFL 1.1 license accompanying the
  font (OFL permits redistribution). Source-of-truth in-repo; no runtime use.

### WPF font reference

Resolve the family from the configured name:

- If the name equals the bundled family (`JetBrains Mono NL`, case-insensitive) → use
  the bundled copy via pack URI so the app is self-contained even if the font is not
  installed: `new FontFamily(new Uri("pack://application:,,,/Fonts/"), "./#JetBrains Mono NL")`.
- Otherwise → `new FontFamily(name)` (any installed font, with comma fallbacks allowed).

### HintCanvas — static Typeface → instance

- `HintCanvas.cs:23-24`: the `static readonly Typeface LabelTypeface` (hardcoded
  `Helvetica, Arial`) becomes an **instance** `Typeface _typeface`, rebuilt in
  `BuildFormatted()` (called on session change and DPI change) from
  `_hints[0].FontFamilyReadValue`. The label weight stays **Bold**.

### Plumbing (mirrors the existing font-size path)

- `OverlayActionConfig.ReadHintFontFamily()` — hot-reload reader (via `EnsureFresh`),
  returns `ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["HintFontFamily"]`, default
  `JetBrains Mono NL`. Mirrors `ReadHintFontSize` (`OverlayActionConfig.cs:526`).
- `OverlayViewModel`: `_fontFamilyRaw` field, read in **both** ctors (mirror
  `_fontSizeRaw` at `:128` and `:178`); `EffectiveFontFamily` property (no zone
  variant — zones share the family, only the size differs). Passed at the single
  `HintViewModel` call site (`OverlayViewModel.cs:211`).
- `HintViewModel`: add `FontFamilyReadValue` string property + ctor param (mirror
  `FontSizeReadValue`). `HintCanvas.BuildFormatted` reads `_hints[0].FontFamilyReadValue`.

### Config

- `App.config`: `<add key="HintFontFamily" value="JetBrains Mono NL" />` next to
  `HintFontSize` (`:128`). No `--` inside the XML comment (MSB3249).
- Not added to the Options dialog: many hot-reload settings are already App.config-only
  (Nudge*, Zone*, LeaderBindings, GridLayouts), so this is consistent. Hot-reload via
  `hap.exe.config` edit + re-trigger still works.

## Verification

- **CI** (`.github/workflows/build.yml`, `windows-latest`, MSBuild + vstest) — must be
  green. Key risk: the `<Resource>` pack URI + family name must resolve (a wrong family
  name compiles fine but renders a fallback font at runtime — undetectable by CI).
- **Manual (Windows box):** overlay labels render in JetBrains Mono NL (monospace,
  vs the current proportional Helvetica); set `HintFontFamily=Consolas` and re-trigger
  → labels switch (installed-font path); unset → bundled default. Confirm 2-char labels
  (e.g. `af`) are monospace-spaced.

## Risks

- **Pack-URI family-name mismatch** (silent fallback) — mitigated by verifying the
  family name from the TTF name tables (above); must confirm visually on-box.
- **`<Resource>` build item** — must be `<Resource>` (embedded), not `<Content>`, or the
  pack URI cannot resolve the font.
- **NL vs ligature** — chose NL to avoid punctuation-label ligatures; no downside vs
  the base font for A–Z.
- **License** — JetBrains Mono is SIL OFL 1.1 (redistribution permitted); `OFL.txt`
  included in-repo.
